_about: Extra mods PZO leaves alone, on top of the lists built into the jar. Each entry is a piece of the mod's script path: its Workshop ID as /<id>/ and its folder name as /<folder> for local copies. pacedExempt = OnTick, OnPlayerUpdate and OnZombieUpdate run every frame. mapLoadExempt = LoadGridsquare handlers run straight away. The entries below are already built in, so they change nothing; they show the format.
